result:
All 617 tests pass. The implementation is complete:

1. **`src/types/permission.ts`** — added `"project:change_lead"` to the `PermissionAction` union.
2. **`src/lib/permissions.ts`** — added `"project:change_lead": "admin"` to `ROLE_MATRIX`, and added it to `OWNERSHIP_ESCALATIONS` (the existing `isOwnedByActor` project case already checks `resource.leadId === actor.userId`, so the current lead gets the escalation regardless of role).
3. **`src/schemas/project.ts`** — added `changeProjectLeadSchema` (`{ orgId, projectId, leadId }`, `leadId` required but nullable) and `ChangeProjectLeadInput`.
4. **`src/server/services/project-service.ts`** — added `changeProjectLead`, which: checks tenant scope, loads the project (`NotFoundError` if missing), checks `project:change_lead` (`PermissionDeniedError`), checks not archived (`AlreadyArchivedError`), and — when `leadId` isn't `null` — looks up the candidate as an active org member (`NotFoundError` otherwise) and verifies they could themselves perform `project:update` on the project via their own role (`PermissionDeniedError` otherwise), before delegating to `projectRepo.updateProject`.
